
  ╭─────────────────────────────────────────────╮
  │  /free                                      │
  │  Cheapest Model                             │
  ╰─────────────────────────────────────────────╯

  Summary:
    Instantly switch to the cheapest OpenRouter model.

  Usage:
    /free

  Details:
    Switches to DeepSeek V4 Flash on OpenRouter ($0.09/$0.18 per 1M tokens).
    Requires an OPENROUTER_API_KEY in your .env file.

  Examples:
    $ /free

  Tips:
    Tip: Great for quick tasks where you don't need a top-tier model.

  Related: /switch  /config
